style: Detailed digital concept painting with cinematic matte-painting finish. The setting is 'the garrison': a near-future military outpost of dark poured concrete and gunmetal steel, where every panel, door, window and crate has chamfered 45-degree cut corners instead of round ones. Night. Cold blue-black palette: shadows at #0b0d10, mid-tones #12161b and #1a2028, slate #2a323d on the lit edges. The only saturated colour anywhere is acid volt-lime #d4ff3a, used sparingly and only as emitted light: signal lamps, thin light strips, a targeting bracket, glow caught in mist. Thin ground fog, fine rain or dust drifting through the light, wet reflective surfaces. Crisp hard-surface detail, visible bolts, weld seams, cable runs and stencilled panel lines (lines only, never letters). Subtle film grain, strong readable silhouette, generous dark negative space. Any figures are small, distant, faceless silhouettes.

emblem: Composition: one object, centred, filling about 70% of the square, viewed three-quarter from slightly above, sitting on a flat pure #0b0d10 background with no horizon, no floor texture and no vignette, so it can be dropped into a dark tile. One volt-lime light source on the object itself. Even margin on all four sides.

slots.use: Banner on the 'Nothing here' page.

slots.prompt: A long, empty concrete service corridor inside the garrison that ends in a blank chamfered wall where a door should be. One volt-lime ceiling strip flickers at the far end; the rest of the lights are off. Cable trays overhead, a little dust in the air. One-point perspective, wide 2:1 frame, quiet and slightly eerie rather than threatening.

slots.alt: A quiet watch post, lamp on, nothing to report.
slots.prompt: A single small watch post on a concrete plinth: a chamfered sentry box with an open shutter and one steady volt-lime lamp on its roof, a folded stool beside it, nobody there. All quiet. Must stay readable when shrunk to 120 pixels, so keep the shape simple and the lamp obvious.

slots.name: hero
slots.use: Not shown since the landing page redesign. Kept so the existing file still has a slot.
slots.alt: The garrison gate at night, lit by one volt-lime signal lamp.
slots.prompt: Wide establishing shot of the garrison's main gate seen from outside at night: a massive chamfered blast door set into a concrete wall, slightly open, with a single volt-lime signal lamp above it and a thin lime light strip tracing the door's edge. A watchtower rises on the right third with one lit window. Fog rolls along wet ground that mirrors the lime glow. Composition: the gate and tower sit in the right two-thirds; the left third fades to near-black empty wall and sky for a headline to sit on. Horizon low, camera at eye level, 35mm lens.

slots.name: hero-light
slots.use: Not shown since the landing page redesign. Kept so the existing file still has a slot.
slots.alt: The garrison gate at dawn in pale fog.
slots.prompt: The same gate and watchtower as the night hero, same camera and framing, but at overcast dawn: pale grey-white fog (#f4f6f8 to #d5dbe2) fills the scene, the concrete reads as soft mid-grey, and the lamp and door strip glow a deeper olive-lime #4d6b00 instead of volt. The left third dissolves into plain pale fog for a headline. Low contrast, airy, no dark shadows heavier than #5a6472.
slots.styleOverride: Detailed digital concept painting with cinematic matte-painting finish, same world as the night pieces: chamfered 45-degree corners on every hard surface, crisp bolts and weld seams, subtle film grain, faceless distant figures only.

The feeling is 'locked, and it would take two keys'.
